Jordan P: Heads-up: onboarding mobile sample hit intermittent 400s from /rerank. Error says `embedding.length mismatch`.
Ina Q: repro steps?
Jordan P: Mobile helper batches on-device to save RTT. If auth refresh triggers a retry we sometimes re-send mutated backing arrays and one vector ends up 1535 vs expected 1536.
Rob C: which SDK and platform?
Jordan P: C# mobile SDK v1.2.0 on Xamarin. We use ArraySegment<float> views to avoid copies. Snippet:
```csharp
var batches = BatchHelper.Chunk(vecs, 6);
await Task.WhenAll(batches.Select(b => SendRerankAsync(b)));
// SendRerankAsync may enqueue the same ArraySegment for retry
```
Ina Q: ArraySegment shares the same array; if something resizes or copies later the view can change. Short-term hack: clone segment before enqueue.
Rob C: Agree. Medium fix: retry middleware should clone request bodies or mark them immutable at HTTP client layer so all helpers are safe.
Mobile SDK Bot: filed issue mobile-sdk#212: "retry-middleware: deep-copy body to avoid ArraySegment/view mutation".
Jordan P: Also noticed response ordering changed when server deduped duplicates. Client assumed stable order and remapped scores by index; got scrambled results.
Ina Q: Platform can we get an ordering map when dedupe runs? Something like `input_to_output_map`. That plus richer error info (batch_index, expected_dim, got_dim) would speed triage.
Platform APIs: We can add optional `input_to_output_map` to rerank responses when dedupe happens and include `batch_index`, `expected_dim`, `got_dim` in embedding error objects. We'll keep backward compatibility.
Rob C: action items: 1) mobile sample hotfix to clone segments before enqueue (hotfix), 2) add deep-clone in retry middleware (sdk change), 3) API error enrichment + input_to_output_map (platform), 4) add mobile+desktop parity E2E for batching+retry+dedeup.
CI Bot: sampleapp PR passed CI \u2705
Jordan P: temporary onboarding workaround: set env ONBOARD_BATCH_RETRY=disabled for mobile until middleware lands. Adding note to onboarding README.
Ina Q: also adding SDK lint rule to warn when ArraySegment/Span/Buffer views are used directly as request bodies.
Jordan P: thanks all — hotfix unblocked the onboarding run. Leaving issue links in the sample-app repo. :tada:
